query_analysis.original_query: The compressor in our refrigeration cycle is showing unexpected surges in discharge pressure. Could it be related to liquid carryover from the separator upstream?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Perform a detailed investigation into the causes of unexpected surges in discharge pressure in our refrigeration cycle compressor, specifically evaluating if liquid carryover from the upstream separator is causing this issue.

selected_agents.role: Root cause investigation of compressor pressure surges
Analysis of upstream separator performance and liquid carryover
Assessment of compressor control systems and pressure regulation

communication_strategy.information_flow: Exchange of diagnostic data and collaborative analysis between agents

clarification_questions: When did the unexpected pressure surges in the compressor discharge begin?
Have there been any recent changes to the refrigeration cycle operating conditions or maintenance performed on the system?
Can you provide data on the separator performance and any indications of liquid carryover?
Are there any signs of liquid presence at the compressor inlet?
Have you observed any anomalies in the compressor control system or pressure regulation mechanisms?
